operative_clauses.original_operative_text:
Section 1. Establishment of the Award. In order to encourage love of country, 
service to the people of the United States, and support for our Armed 
Forces, and in order to recognize the unique and lifelong service of Bob 
Hope to the United States Armed Forces and to the Nation through his 
unwavering patriotism and dedication to maintaining the morale of the 
troops he entertained for nearly six decades, and on the occasion of his 
100th birthday, there is hereby established the Bob Hope American Patriot 
Award (Award). 
Sec. 2. Granting and Presentation of the Award.

to an organization that meets the same criteria.

research_rationale: EO13306 creates an enduring discretionary award program and four continuing administration rules. Its five operative clauses contain no fixed end date, event-triggered cessation, delegation transfer or savings qualification. The exact retained official Federal Register page was visually compared to its complete text and signature; its byte hash matches both stage21 custody and full_run source metadata. The current U.S.Code note reproduces the same five clauses, corroborating continuation throughOctober9 rather than supplying a new source of authority. To assess the October14cutoff, the researcher reviewed the saved OFR catalog current to that cutoff, all numeric13306hits and unparsed-note hits, and the bounded eCFR and later-order-text scan described below. Two other catalog numericmatches are page/document-number collisions; no adverse disposition or amendment is identified for this order. This supports continued operation of the original authority within those bounded searches. No judicial or statutory contrarylead is identified in the saved inputs; unnamed statutory displacement and uncatalogued decisions are limitations of the bounded search, not invented findings of absence. No human certification or GPOpublished fixity confirmation is asserted.
